title: Buck converter cooling chain
description:
Design the cooling for a synchronous buck converter: Vin = 36 V, Vout = 12 V, Iout = 30 A. Both MOSFETs are identical: Rds(on) = 4.42 mOhm at 25 C with temperature coefficient alpha = 0.004 per C, i.e. Rds(Tj) = Rds25 * (1 + alpha * (Tj - 25)); switching transition tr + tf = 25 ns; gate charge Qg = 83 nC at Vgs = 10 V. Use this loss model: P_cond = Iout^2 * Rds(Tj) (the two FETs together conduct the full output current), P_sw = 0.5 * Vin * Iout * (tr + tf) * fsw, P_gate = 2 * Qg * Vgs * fsw, P = P_cond + P_sw + P_gate. Efficiency eta = Pout / (Pout + P) with Pout = Vout * Iout.

Both FETs share one heat sink: Tj = Ta + P * (RthJC + RthCS + Rsa), with RthJC = 0.76 C/W, RthCS = 0.27 C/W, Ta = 40 C inside the enclosure. Note Rds depends on Tj, so solve the thermal loop self-consistently. Rsa depends on the air velocity v through the sink; interpolate linearly between the catalog points and clamp outside them. Air velocity v = Q / 3600 / A_duct with A_duct = 0.0053 m2, where Q (m3/h) is the fan operating point: the flow at which the fan's static pressure (interpolate linearly between its curve points) equals the enclosure system curve dP = k * Q^2 with k = 0.0097 Pa/(m3/h)^2. With no fan, v = 0.

Ripple: inductor L = 6.1 uH, output capacitor C = 170 uF, D = Vout / Vin. dI = Vout * (1 - D) / (L * fsw) must not exceed 6.0 A and dV = dI / (8 * C * fsw) must not exceed 150 mV.

Constraints: fsw between 50 and 500 kHz; Tj <= 115 C; eta >= 95.5%; fan noise <= 40 dBA (no fan = 0 dBA); heat sink height <= 35 mm; heat sink price + fan price <= 15.

Heat sink catalog:
  HS-1: Rsa = 12.74 / 6.37 / 4.46 / 3.19 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 15 mm, price 2.10
  HS-2: Rsa = 8.5 / 4.25 / 2.97 / 2.12 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 25 mm, price 3.44
  HS-3: Rsa = 5.84 / 2.76 / 1.91 / 1.38 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 35 mm, price 6.93
  HS-4: Rsa = 4.04 / 1.91 / 1.33 / 0.96 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 45 mm, price 11.44
  HS-5: Rsa = 2.76 / 1.27 / 0.9 / 0.64 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 60 mm, price 16.92
  HS-6: Rsa = 1.91 / 0.9 / 0.64 / 0.48 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 80 mm, price 26.68

Fan catalog (or use no fan):
  FAN-A (40x40x10 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 31.9], [8.0, 19.1], [12.7, 9.6], [15.9, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 28 dBA, price 2.82
  FAN-B (60x60x25 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 47.8], [21.2, 28.7], [34.0, 14.3], [42.5, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 32 dBA, price 5.58
  FAN-C (80x80x25 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 42.5], [37.2, 25.5], [59.5, 12.7], [74.3, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 30 dBA, price 8.72
  FAN-D (80x80x38 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 95.6], [58.4, 57.3], [93.5, 28.7], [116.8, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 42 dBA, price 13.30
  FAN-E (92x92x38 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 116.8], [85.0, 70.1], [135.9, 35.0], [169.9, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 46 dBA, price 18.62

Any design satisfying every constraint passes. Return {"fsw_hz": <number>, "heatsink": "<id>", "fan": "<id>" or null}.
